text:
elena: quick follow-up from today's all-hands sec Q&A. putting final clarifications here so product + eng teams have a single thread for SOC2/ISO evidence, VPC choices, audit-log export mechanics, and KMS/BYOK rotation. ask follow-ups below.
dan: short summary: 1) evidence packs available for SOC2/ISO (control mappings + log slices + config snapshots). 2) exports: hosted -> our managed bucket; Private/Dedicated -> customer bucket via export role. 3) VPC: prefer Interface Endpoints (PrivateLink) for prod. 4) KMS/BYOK supported; rotation workflow required.

priya: evidence request process: use the compliance form (https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance). required fields: org, project, evidence_owner, control_scope, desired_retention_days. standard turnaround 72 hours; expedited options available for an SLA fee. include sample prompts or test runs for privacy-related controls.

leah: question: for Private exports do teams need to create buckets? and can we enable S3 Object Lock for WORM?
dan: yes for Private we ask you to pre-create the bucket/container and share the ARN/url. Object Lock must be enabled at bucket creation time for AWS, so plan ahead. we provide a minimal bucket policy snippet and create a cross-account role that assumes the export role. example export prefix: s3://<customer-bucket>/redwood/audit/<cluster-id>/YYYY/MM/DD/

elena: retention defaults to 90 days. to request 180 or 365 days set retention_days in the compliance form. note: long retention may incur extra storage billing. legal-hold or immutability requests require coordination with legal/finance.

priya: KMS/BYOK specifics: supported flows: AWS CMKs, imported key material (BYOK), and HSM-backed keys. for BYOK we capture import events, key usage slices (CloudTrail or equivalent), and provide an import manifest. rotation: we recommend a 90-day cadence for high-sensitivity customers; if you manage rotation externally include the rotation SLA in the onboarding request.

leah: auditors asked about proof of custody and key usage. what do we provide?
elena: for CMKs we provide CloudTrail extracts showing Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls and the principal ARNs. for imported keys we provide the import manifest, timestamped import event, and any HSM attestation docs if HSM used. chain-of-custody artifacts are coordinated during onboarding.

dan: operational note: if your service uses prefix/KV caching or stateful caches include that in the evidence request so we can capture relevant traces. we capture trace windows carefully to avoid hitting latency SLOs.

leah: can we get a short one-pager and sample IAM policy + bucket policy?
dan: yes. i'll post a one-pager in #eng-docs today with: request template, sample trust policy, sample bucket policy for AWS/GCP/Azure, and a short runbook for safe cache trace capture.

audit-bot: Created ticket COMP-6122 to track evidence & retention requests referenced in this thread.

elena: office hours: security + eng-platform will host a 30m session next Tue 10am PT to walk through the one-pager and onboarding steps. sign-up link: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-office. we'll publish slides + runbook after. if you can't make it, post questions here or attach them to COMP-6122.

leah: thanks all 1 will collect product questions and add them to the ticket. closing for now.
